title: Process analysis and risk minimisation
summary: Conceptual approaches to examining business and organisational processes – with a focus on interfaces, improvement potential and risks.

text: Conceptual approaches to examining business and organisational processes. The focus is on interfaces, improvement potential, risks and starting points for improving transparency and process quality.
Independently developed conceptual analytical approach for business and organisational processes.
The aim is to make connections visible and to develop a structured basis for decisions on possible improvements.
